{{Quote|Let's try the Core Comestible Warehouse. It's bigger than Keldabe, and if they haven't got it, it doesn't exist.|Nyreen Vollen on the Core Comestible Warehouse|<ref name="IC 501st" />}}
The '''Core Comestible Warehouse''' was a store on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was larger in terms of size compared to [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], which was a city on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. It was said that if they didn't sell the item, it didn't exist.<ref name="IC 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], while waiting for the right time to extract [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]] [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and [[Darman Skirata]] in her [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] and six [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s went to the Core Comestible Warehouse to buy supplies for [[Clan Skirata]] back on Mandalore.<ref name="IC 501st" />
